description: This Java class defines a message object `CheckForActivity` used within the Eclipse Ditto project. It is designed for internal communication within an actor system, allowing an actor to check its activity status based on sequence number and access counter, and potentially trigger termination if no activity has occurred.

classes.name: CheckForActivity
classes.description: A message class used by the ThingPersistenceActor to check its activity status, containing sequence number and access counter information.

methods.name: getCurrentSequenceNr
methods.description: Returns the last sequence number of the actor to indicate activity.

methods.name: getCurrentAccessCounter
methods.description: Returns the current access counter to indicate activity.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals() to compare CheckForActivity instances based on sequence number and access counter.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode() for consistent hashing based on sequence number and access counter.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the CheckForActivity instance.
